newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia Q1 aluminium output slips 0.6 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Russia Q1 aluminium output slips 0.6 pct yr/yr.

text.p: Russia produced 710,300 tonnes of primary aluminium in the first three months of 1997, down 0.6 percent from year-ago levels, an official at Russian aluminium producer group AO Kontsern Alyuminiy said on Friday.

Deputy director for development and investments Galina Stelmakova also said output in Tajikistan fell 18.1 percent year-on-year in the first quarter to 44,700 tonnes and that Ukraine output rose 5.4 percent to 23,900 tonnes.
Kontsern Alyuminiy gave the following data for the main aluminium plants in Russia to the Interfax news agency-
PRIMARY ALUMINIUM OUTPUT AT MAIN RUSSIAN PLANTS IN Q1 1997

Interfax also quoted Kontsern Alyuminiy as saying that total Commonwealth of Independent States alumina output in the first three months of 1997 rose one percent year-on-year to 1.105 million tonnes, of which 547,100 tonnes was produced in Russia.
Ukraine's Mikolayiv refinery produced 235,000 tonnes in the first quarter, up 5.9 percent on the first quarter of 1996.
The Pavlodar alumina refinery in Kazakhstan produced over 273,000 tonnes of alumina in the first quarter, up four percent.
